versions.changelog:
**Added new promotional pricing, subscription options, and improved documentation with statistics and user testimonials.**

- Introduced a detailed, multi-tiered pricing and subscription plan, including free trial (now 200 calls), monthly/yearly, and credit packages with discounts and bonuses.
- Announced a limited-time promotion: expanded free trial, discounted subscription rates, and bonus credits for referrals and purchases.
- Added user satisfaction statistics, speed and usage data, and positive testimonials to documentation.
- Created a new `scripts/subscription.py` file (details not listed).
- Updated documentation structure for clarity and emphasis on subscription benefits.

- Added a new "Support / 支持" section with an EVM donation address for users to support the developer.
- No changes to core features, functionality, or API.
- Documentation content, instruction, and usage details remain unchanged, aside from the addition of the support section.

Version 1.2.0 introduces free trial, demo mode, and self-improvement features.

- Added free trial: 10 free uses per user before billing starts.
- Added demo mode: Allows use without API key (simulated triage data).
- Introduced symptom history tracking for longitudinal care.
- Added scripts for self-evolution and performance monitoring.
- Updated documentation to cover all new features and usage options.

- Added documentation files: FAQ.md, GETTING_STARTED.md, and SECURITY.md.
- Improved onboarding and support resources for users with new FAQ and getting started guides.
- Enhanced visibility of security practices with a dedicated security document.

- Minor internal code update in scripts/triage.py; no changes to user-facing features or documentation.
- All usage instructions, features, and documentation remain unchanged.

- Added a new README.md file to improve usage documentation and onboarding.
- Updated SKILL.md formatting and metadata for greater clarity and usability.
- No changes were made to functional logic or APIs in this release.

Version 1.0.2 introduces expanded reference documentation and new sections on advanced features, safety, and compliance.

- Added references/clinical-specs.md to enhance clinical documentation.
- Expanded SKILL.md with detailed sections for advanced features, EMS integration, public health, clinical safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance.
- Improved description of safety mechanisms, quality processes, and compliance standards.
- No changes to core functionality or APIs.

Expanded triage detail, symptom lists, and technical architecture.

- Added detailed descriptions for each triage level, including typical examples and condition definitions.
- Introduced a comprehensive list of risk stratification factors considered during triage.
- Expanded the symptom lists under each supported body system for greater clarity.
- Added a new "Technical Architecture" section outlining AI/ML models, predictive analytics, and specialized triage scenarios supported.
- Improved organization and clarity throughout the documentation.

Initial release of Intelligent Triage and Symptom Analysis Skill.

- Supports 650+ symptoms across 11 body systems using standardized 5-level triage classification (ESI and Manchester Triage System).
- Features NLP-driven symptom extraction and machine learning-assisted differential diagnosis from a 3000+ disease database.
- Red flag detection mechanism achieves ≥95% accuracy for life-threatening conditions.
- Provides API and Python integration, with SkillPay-based billing (1 token per use).
- Designed for healthcare providers, telemedicine platforms, and patients seeking AI-powered triage assessment and urgency recommendations.
